# Zealous

> Zealous is a creative PR, social media and GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation)
> specialist agency based in the UK, founded by Yasmine Triana. Zealous helps
> ambitious businesses build one strategy that wins trust with journalists,
> audiences, and AI search engines alike.

Zealous combines earned media (press, thought leadership, awards), owned media
(websites and social built for AI visibility and human engagement), and
in-person/community activity, guided by an audit-activate-track-and-adapt
methodology.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://www.zealouspr.com/): overview of Zealous and why GEO
  matters alongside traditional PR.
- [Services](https://www.zealouspr.com/services/): full breakdown of earned
  media, owned media, and in-person/community services, plus methodology.
- [About](https://www.zealouspr.com/about/): founder Yasmine Triana's
  background and the agency's working values.
- [Results](https://www.zealouspr.com/case-studies/): how Zealous measures
  client results.
- [Blog — The GEO Nerd](https://www.zealouspr.com/blog/): articles on PR and
  GEO strategy.
- [Contact](https://www.zealouspr.com/contact/): how to get in touch.
